title: Neuro De-Armoring Cards, 4 November (3)
intro: Six stretches for you to edit. I checked all of them myself in Pangram's web app, one paragraph at a time. For four of them, my two tries and Codex's rewrite read AI. For the other two, the paragraph read better, but fixing its one weak sentence moved the others. Each card links every check and the readers' notes.
Each card shows your post's paragraph, or my version where it's already in the article (the 5-HTP "Who this is for"). Edit it the way you would, or keep it as it is.
Your answers save as you click. When you're done, click Copy my answers (or Save them as a file) and send them to me.
